description: This is a PHP source file defining a migration class for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It contains methods to update database schema, permissions, menu configurations, internationalization strings, and other system settings as part of version 5.0.0 update process.
external_methods: Doctrine DBAL methods for schema and data manipulation

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents a database schema and data migration for OrangeHRM version 5.0.0, equipped with methods to update schema, permissions, language strings, and system configurations.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps, including schema changes, permission inserts, menu configurations, internationalization updates, and data fixes.

methods.name: configureTimeMenuItemsIfTimesheetStartDateDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables Time menu items based on the timesheet start date configuration.

methods.name: configureLeaveMenuItemsIfLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables Leave menu items based on leave period configuration.

methods.name: configureMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to toggle menu item statuses based on configuration.

methods.name: addTimezoneColumnsToAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Adds timezone name columns to attendance records and updates their values.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Updates the menu configurator class for a specific module and screen.

methods.name: updateModuleDisplayNames
methods.description: Updates display names for various modules.

methods.name: insertI18nGroups
methods.description: Inserts internationalization groups into the database.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the LangStringHelper instance.

methods.name: getTranslationHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the TranslationHelper instance.

methods.name: cleanUniqueIdTable
methods.description: Deletes certain entries from the hs_hr_unique_id table.

methods.name: hideAddonMenuItems
methods.description: Hides specific menu items such as Claim and LDAP Configuration.
